{{Top|leg}}
The '''auto enhancement''' system was a variety of programs installed on some [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] which worked with the craft's [[Top tracker|tracking]] and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems to direct a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to its destination without the need for manual [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] control.
